step.caption: Start: A, B and C each hold a vector [a,b,c] of counters, all zero · A = [0,0,0] · B = [0,0,0] · C = [0,0,0]
A has a local event: it increments its own slot · A: [0,0,0] -> [1,0,0]
A has a second local event before sending: it increments its own slot again · A: [1,0,0] -> [2,0,0]
A sends its vector to B · B receives [2,0,0]: max([0,0,0],[2,0,0])=[2,0,0], then +1 own slot -> [2,1,0]
Meanwhile, C has a local event of its own: it increments its own slot · C: [0,0,0] -> [0,0,1] · C's local event (frozen) = [0,0,1]
B sends its vector to C · C receives [2,1,0]: max([0,0,1],[2,1,0])=[2,1,1], then +1 own slot -> [2,1,2]
Concurrent: A's vector when it sent to B [2,0,0] and C's local event [0,0,1] - neither is <= the other
Ordered: A's vector [2,0,0] <= C's final vector [2,1,2] in every slot - A's send happened-before C's receive
